Privacy Policy

This policy explains what information NEXORA collects and how it is used.

Information we collect

  • Newsletter signup: email address and, optionally, first name.
  • Usage data: pages viewed, searches performed, and tool/affiliate link clicks (aggregated, not sold).
  • Admin accounts: name, email and hashed password for editorial staff.

How we use it

To operate the newsletter, improve content and site performance, and maintain admin security.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time via the link in every email.
